name: agentic-engineering
displayName: Agentic Engineering: give your repo a memory
description: Your coding agent starts every session knowing nothing about your project. /agent-memory reads your real code, writes CLAUDE.md and a small docs layer from it, grades the repo 0 to 5 before and after, and lists the claims in your own docs that the code contradicts. Deletes nothing, overwrites nothing, stops once for approval.
